input.conditions: n Boolean variables; Literal {variable,value}; OR, force and implication clauses

output.conditions: SAT flag and complete owned uint8 assignment; UNSAT has empty assignment

constraints.limits: size_t, container max_size and allocation limits additionally apply
constraints.numeric_and_state: n Boolean variables; Literal {variable,value}; OR, force and implication clauses; SAT flag and complete owned uint8 assignment; UNSAT has empty assignment
constraints.errors: Invalid shape/index/domain rejected; allocations may throw; algorithm-specific overflow/tolerance behavior in documentation

complexity.space: 16q stored clauses; 16q temporary arcs; CSR/SCC O(n+q), output n bytes
complexity.guarantee: Worst-case unless explicitly stated; no calibrated performance claim

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative owned payload lower bound on current 64-bit platform, not peak/latency feasibility

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants and reductions in documentation, not formal verification

provenance.implementation: Independently rewritten for this project; source motivates algorithm and constraints
